caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale on a cream-colored rectangular sheet of paper. It depicts a silhouette of a winged human figure, oriented horizontally and facing right, blowing into a long, flared trumpet with both hands. The figure is in a flying pose, with wings extended backward, left leg bent at the knee, and right leg extended straight behind. The head features a crown-like or spiked shape. A vertical rod is attached below the figure's torso, extending downward. In the lower left corner, there is a small scale marked in inches from 0 to 6. In the lower right corner, the text "SALVATORE BORRAZZO" is printed. The drawing is enclosed within a single-line border, and there are faint stains and signs of aging near the corners of the paper.
title: Weather Vane - Angel Gabriel
